cycles.explanation: Ohio State, Alabama, Indiana, Texas, Ole Miss, Georgia, Kentucky, LSU, Tennessee, Missouri, Florida, Oklahoma, Auburn, Mississippi State, Iowa, South Carolina and Michigan form a loop: following every head-to-head result among them leads back to where it started, so no ordering can honour all 33 of them. The weakest link was Texas's 24-23 win over Ohio State (a 1-point win at home is worth -1.5 once venue is accounted for; the winner rates 3.3 points worse on the power ratings. Since then: Texas has more losses, 2 to 1; Texas has lost 2 since and Ohio State none; so the resume order decides how far apart they sit), so it was set aside, along with 10 other results in this loop.

BYU, Arizona, Texas Tech, Houston, Oklahoma State, UCF and Cincinnati form a loop: following every head-to-head result among them leads back to where it started, so no ordering can honour all 8 of them. The weakest link was UCF's 39-31 win over BYU (+5.5 adjusted margin; the winner rates 11.1 points worse on the power ratings; the loser fared better against 1 shared opponent. Since then: UCF has more losses, 3 to 1; so the resume order decides how far apart they sit), so it was set aside, along with 1 other result in this loop.

source.attribution: Data: CollegeFootballData.com -- betting lines, play-by-play PPA, and Strength of Record, Strength of Schedule and FPI via ESPN

stages: Stage 1 - rank every team by what it has achieved and how good it is: 0.55 x Strength of Record + 0.25 x market neutral-field rank + 0.2 x opponent-adjusted points added per play (all national ranks, lower is better).
Stage 2 - adjust for how your losses actually look: the venue and margin of each defeat, the quality of your best win, and how comfortably you win.
Stage 3 - when a result spans more than 15 places, pull both teams 0.35 of the way to their midpoint; the upset says both were mis-rated.
Stage 4 - reorder so as few head-to-head results as possible are contradicted, weighing each result by how convincing it was against how far a team would have to move.
Stage 5 - report every contradiction loop and every overridden result, so nothing is hidden.
methodology.summary: base = 0.55 x SoR + 0.25 x Mkt + 0.2 x PPA; pool 40; H2H strength 4, drift exponent 1.5; upset regression on (gap 15, 0.35)
